title: Ash Fontana – Investing in Artificial Intelligence at Zetta Ventures (First Meeting, EP.11)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: My guest on today's first meeting is Ash Fontana, a managing director, at Zeta Ventures.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest on today's first meeting is Ash Fontana, a managing director, at Zeta Ventures, which is a venture capital firm that backs artificial intelligence companies with B2B business models.

key_points.text: The firm invests in early stage companies with unique data sets and models and rolls up their sleeves to help founders by using a playbook Zeta created specifically for AI companies..

thesis: The episode introduces Ash Fontana, a managing director at Zetta Ventures, a firm that invests in early-stage artificial intelligence companies with B2B business models, unique data sets, and models. The conversation outlines Ash's background as an entrepreneur and investor, including his role in building the money side of Angel List alongside Naval Ravikant, and sets the stage for a discussion on Zetta's thesis, team, strategy, and approach to sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio construction.
